matches.name: Finset.sum_ite_index
matches.signature:
theorem prod_ite_index (p : Prop) [Decidable p] (s t : Finset ι) (f : ι → M) :
    ∏ x ∈ if p then s else t, f x = if p then ∏ x ∈ s, f x else ∏ x ∈ t, f x

matches.name: Sum
matches.docstring:
The disjoint union of types `α` and `β`, ordinarily written `α ⊕ β`.

An element of `α ⊕ β` is either an `a : α` wrapped in `Sum.inl` or a `b : β` wrapped in `Sum.inr`.
`α ⊕ β` is not equivalent to the set-theoretic union of `α` and `β` because its values include an
indication of which of the two ty

matches.name: Fintype.sum_ite_eq'
matches.signature: lemma prod_ite_eq' (i : ι) (f : ι → M) : ∏ j, (if j = i then f j else 1) = f i

matches.name: Finset.sum_ite
matches.signature:
theorem prod_ite {s : Finset ι} {p : ι → Prop} [DecidablePred p] (f g : ι → M) :
    ∏ x ∈ s, (if p x then f x else g x) = (∏ x ∈ s with p x, f x) * ∏ x ∈ s with ¬p x, g x

matches.name: Fin.partialSum
matches.signature: def partialProd (f : Fin n → M) (i : Fin (n + 1)) : M
matches.docstring:
For `f = (a₁, ..., aₙ)` in `αⁿ`, `partialSum f` is
`(0, a₁, a₁ + a₂, ..., a₁ + ... + aₙ)` in `αⁿ⁺¹`.

matches.name: Fin.sum_univ_one
matches.signature: theorem prod_univ_one (f : Fin 1 → M) : ∏ i, f i = f 0

matches.name: Finset.weightedVSubOfPoint_filter_of_ne
matches.docstring:
A weighted sum over `{x ∈ s | pred x}` equals one over `s` if all the weights at indices in `s`
not satisfying `pred` are zero.
